result.question: When did Jotham address Shechem's leaders?

readings.answer: On that day, when they made Abimelech king.
readings.support: this day | you have made Abimelech, the son of his maidservant, king over the leaders of Shechem

assessments.reason: The passage marks the time as “this day” for both killing the seventy sons and making Abimelech king; referring to the day they made Abimelech king identifies the same day as the key.

result.reason: “This day” ties both events together, so either event names the same day Jotham addressed them.
